roadmap.text: Play the story from the opening mission (Gone Fishing) through the five chapters to the final mission. The 12 story trophies unlock automatically as you finish each chapter and each named mission, and none of them can be missed. One thing to do in Chapter 1 before it closes: meditate at the first meditation spot at home — Positive Mental Attitude is the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable, because that first spot becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. PowerPyx puts the story at about 60 to 80 hours.
roadmap.title: Play the story — and protect the one missable trophy

roadmap.text: After the story, or alongside it, finish the mission strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — each one ends with a trophy for its final mission, and Bret's strand includes hunting a unique animal. Finishing strands also builds toward Strangers & Freaks, which needs 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Take the strands as their markers appear on the map.
roadmap.title: Finish the side-character strands

roadmap.text: Work the activities: 250 stunts (PowerPyx counts 397 across the map, and the 100% checklist needs 300), gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun drone race win at every location, 20 different race wins, fishing against Cal, one arcade game, and bowling at Kolt & Associates. Try each activity type once for Master of None, and work the 50 challenges as you go — they stack up across everything you do.
roadmap.title: Activities, races and stunts

roadmap.text: Pull off the robberies: 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store without being detected, an illegal operation for each gang, and 3 shops back-to-back with your partner. Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner for Hot Together. Launder Marked Bills through your contacts toward $250,000 for Dime on the Dollar — robberies are the steadiest source of Marked Bills.
roadmap.title: Robberies and the wanted level

roadmap.text: Sweep the collectibles and the map: 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 distinct vehicles discovered, every garage property purchased, 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app, and every region of Leonida explored. Finish the meditation spots too — 18 spots in 10 locations — so Positive Mental Attitude is done. Work region by region so nothing needs a second sweep.
roadmap.title: Collectibles, vehicles and exploring Leonida

roadmap.text: Spend $100,000 across all shops for Treat Yo Self, then open the 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) and clean up whatever lines are left. PowerPyx calls A Long Road the hardest trophy and puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, with most of it coming from the other trophies, so by now the list should be short. Once A Long Road pops, Vice Got a Price! — the Platinum — follows at once. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours.
roadmap.title: Money, then 100% — then the Platinum
